examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

examples.text: Лидия Алексеевна, успокойтесь, пожалуйста! Вы как маленькая себя ведёте.
examples.trans: Lydia Alexeyevna, calm down, please! You're behaving like a little girl.

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
In short, girls, listen to me.
Girl, pass me the sugar, please.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'волиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'quit, resign'.

examples.text: Ты можешь уволиться в любой момент.
examples.trans: You can quit at any moment.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: в любой момент = at any moment

examples.text: Любая обезьяна эти выборы выиграет! Ты что, хуже обезьяны?
examples.trans: Any monkey will win this election! What, are you worse than a monkey?

meanings.note: From Latin 'momentum' (movement, brief span of time).

examples.text: А мне что-то уже не хочется. Момент упущен.
examples.trans: Somehow I don't feel like it anymore. The moment has passed.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: платить за + accusative = to pay for

examples.text: А вашу работу вернуть можно. И мы хорошо платим.
examples.trans: But we can get your job back for you. And we pay well.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Или счёт в банке. Потому что они все обманщики.
examples.trans: Or a bank account. Because they are all cheats.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'егда').

examples.trans: She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
Will you be able to come tomorrow morning?

examples.text: Я думаю, что у меня есть мужчина. Он сможет меня защитить.
examples.trans: I think that I have a man. He will be able to protect me.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to find', paired with 'находить'.

examples.text: Ну где я сейчас найду грузчиков?
examples.trans: Well, where am I going to find movers right now?

meanings.note: irregular feminine declension with stem дочер-

examples.text: Простите, это собака дочери. Я с ней гуляю пока.
examples.trans: Sorry, it's my daughter's dog. I'm walking her for now.

учиться.gloss: to study, to be a student; to learn

meanings.en: to study, to be a student
to learn how to do something

examples.text: Но вы же с ним учились вместе!
examples.trans: But you studied together with him!

examples.text: А я всё выучила. Я хорошо учусь.
examples.trans: And I've learned everything. I do well at school.

meanings.note: Core Russian name meaning 'Paris' in everyday speech.

examples.text: А в Париж вас никто замуж не звал?
examples.trans: And nobody asked you to marry him and move to Paris?

examples.text: Однажды, когда я работал в Париже...
examples.trans: Once, when I worked in Paris...
Can you imagine, we lived in Paris.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order
the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?

meanings.note: followed by genitive plural in nominative/accusative

examples.text: Я уже вам сто раз говорила. Я брала двадцать тысяч, вернула тридцать!
examples.trans: I've already told you a hundred times. I borrowed twenty thousand, paid back thirty!

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: в долгу не остаться = to repay a favour

examples.text: Помогите мне! Я в долгу не останусь.
examples.trans: Help me! I'll pay you back, I promise.

выгнать.gloss: to kick out, to evict, to drive out

meanings.en: to kick out, to drive out

examples.text: Для тебя она добрая. А меня она выгонит!
examples.trans: She's kind to you. But she'll kick me out!

examples.text: Значит, меня не выгонят со службы?
examples.trans: Does that mean I won't be fired from service?

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал.
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once.

meanings.note: с первого раза = the first time

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

examples.text: Ты что, с первого раза не понимаешь?
examples.trans: What, you don't understand the first time?

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'drinking party' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: They will kick you out after the first drinking binge.

examples.text: Тогда была моя ошибка. И мы были пьяные.
examples.trans: Back then it was my mistake. And we were drunk.

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

терпеть.gloss: to bear, to put up with; to hold on

meanings.en: to put up with, to bear

meanings.note: e.g. to wait for the toilet

examples.text: Маленькие умеют терпеть, а взрослые нет, понял?
examples.trans: Little ones can hold on, but grown-ups can't, got it?

related.gloss: to be patient for a while

meanings.note: Common substantive noun meaning 'character, temper' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Никто не будет терпеть твой характер.
examples.trans: No one will tolerate your character.

examples.text: Это слово «характер» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'character' is often heard in conversation.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: + dative of the person, + accusative of the drink

examples.text: Ты мне сейчас водку наливаешь, да?
examples.trans: Right now you're pouring me vodka, aren't you?
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

выпить.gloss: to drink, to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink
meanings.note: often used without an object for drinking alcohol

examples.trans: Oh, I've had a bit to drink now.
May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.
